name: bannor_settler
description: a Bannor Settler, a young human pioneer: tousled brown hair, a white hooded mantle over the shoulders, a red tunic with white cuffs and a gold sun emblem on the chest, a brown belt with leather pouches, brown trousers and brown boots, a huge tan canvas backpack on his back topped with a rolled red bedroll and a tin pot hanging from it, and a tall wooden walking staff flying a small white banner with a gold sun near its top, held in his LEFT hand
hands: the banner staff stays in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand on the screen-left side grips the backpack strap at his chest as an empty fist

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the banner staff is lifted up over the head with its banner end pointing up and back, the big backpack on his back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the banner staff cocked behind the head with its banner end hanging down behind the shoulders, the empty right fist tucked in at the backpack strap
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the arm sweeps over the head and the banner staff is level, its banner end pointing to the lower-right
strike.4: contact: staff arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the banner end of the staff smashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the empty right fist swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the banner staff carries on down until its banner end nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, hair trailing back, the backpack swinging
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the banner staff lifts back toward its upright ready angle

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the empty right fist flung out to the left, the staff arm thrown up and out with the banner staff tilted up)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the banner staff leaning out to the right, the empty right fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, staff arm flung up holding the banner staff high, the empty right fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the banner staff lowering, the heavy backpack dragging at his shoulders
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the banner end of the staff resting on the ground at the lower-right, the empty right arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left onto the big backpack, the banner staff slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the big backpack under his shoulders; the banner staff lies on the ground at the lower-right with its white sun banner
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the bedroll and the tin pot settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back over the backpack, eyes closed, the banner staff on the ground beside him
